lines.en: My heavy steps sound.
My tusks push the snow aside.
Each step leaves a pit.
Ice crusts my fur.
I shift my bulk slowly.
I lead the small herd.
I skirt the ice spikes.
The snow groans under me.
My trunk sweeps through the snow.
I cross a frozen stream.
Slow, but I do not stop.
I clear the way with my tusks.
The fur on my back sways.
We walk in a line.
I turn into the wind.
I stand in the snow.
I scoop up snow with my trunk.
The ice spikes make it cold.
I listen to the snow fall.
The calves are behind the drift.
I rub my tusks in the snow.
I wait for the storm to pass.
I blow out a cloud of steam.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以撞倒的树
lines.en: No trees here to push over.
I dig my tusks into the snow.
We stand close together.

lines.zh: 风雪把我埋了半个身子
lines.en: The storm half buries me.
I touch my companion with my trunk.
You must be cold in this snow.
You are shorter than my leg.
My trunk has smelled you.
You are shivering.
Do you want to come closer?
I move slowly, do not block me.

lines.zh: 我的牙只是用来推雪的
lines.en: My tusks are only for pushing snow.
Do not touch my calves.
Your clothes are too thin.
My fur was cut open.
I stepped back and the snow collapsed.
I pulled my trunk back.
This much barely counts for me.
I swayed my bulk.
Ice fell from my fur.

lines.zh: 雪原上回荡着我的低吼
lines.en: My rumble rolls over the snowfield.
The hide on my legs is thick.
I am still standing.
I will not leave for that.
That sweetness cuts sharp through the snow.
Why hold it up high?
Let me smell it.
Set it on the snow.
My trunk is reaching for it.
I could tuck it into my fur.
Just leave it there.
It is not only food, is it?

lines.zh: 你的草味盖过整片雪原。
lines.en: The smell of your grass covers the whole snowfield.
That smell is familiar.
You hit this thick leg of mine.
One shift of mine and you bounce off.
I am all fur and ice.
You stepped on my trunk.
I shifted one step.
The snow scattered.
Bumping me does not help.
Are your bones all right?
I make a path.
I am too heavy to stop quickly.
We are few on this snowfield.
Do not stand at my flank.
The storm will cover any trace.
The calves are far off.
I touched her with my trunk.
The snow is light for now.
I have waited many winters.
That is enough.
My trunk can hold it.
This weight is nothing.
Meat and fur both come from me.
I bring it up to my mouth.
I can carry a lot at once.
I curl it up and eat.
Even in snow I find it.
I pick it up even from underfoot.
This small tree is nice.
Let me push it around first.
You frightened the little ones.
The fur on my back rises.
One step can crush this pit.
I turn toward you.
I lift my trunk and trumpet.
The snow is full of our prints.
You are between me and them.

lines.zh: 我的牙正对着你的胸口。
lines.en: My tusk is leveled at your chest.
I press forward.
I never give way.

lines.zh: 我向你和冰刺之间走过去
lines.en: I move between you and the ice spikes.
I curl my trunk up.
I move my whole bulk toward you.
The snow packs hard under me.
You cannot leave this snowfield.
My trunk is searching for you.
You are hiding behind the ice spikes.
I hear your breathing.
One more step and it is the ice slope.
I would rather not use my tusks.
The snow is deep here.

lines.zh: 我的象牙离你只剩两步。
lines.en: My tusks are only two steps from you.
The wind blows toward you.
Snow falls off the trees.
My tusks sweep across.
You are shoved several meters.
I whip you with my trunk.
My foreleg comes down.
You sink into a snow pit.
You cannot keep your feet.
You are at the ice slope now.
My bellow shakes snow loose.
I would rather not do that twice.
I step into this snow.
A herd emerges from the storm.
My fur is covered in snow.
The ice spikes look familiar.
The calves are beside me.
I shake the snow off my back.
I blow out a plume of steam.
The ground packs down beneath us.

lines.zh: 风雪把我的长毛吹成一片白。
lines.en: The blizzard blows my long coat into a sheet of white.
Winter is long here.
I walk slowly over the ice.
We huddle for warmth.
This snowfield will feed us.
Fire makes me very uncomfortable.
I crushed a wide stretch of snow.
Icy water soaks into my fur.
Snow and ice burst apart.
An arrow sticks in my fur.
Nothing grows under this snow.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，雪都化了
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and melted the snow.
Even the snowfield is gone.
